stem.text: An object is in a uniform gravitational field. The graph shows how the change in gravitational potential energy $\Delta E_\text{P}$ of the object varies with the vertical distance $x$ moved by the object from a fixed point.

stem.alt: Graph of change in potential energy against x, with the vertical axis labelled ΔEP and the horizontal axis labelled x, and 0 marked at the origin.
